CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_accounts(user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id), data TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_identities(kind TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), verified_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(kind,value))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_affiliations(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), parish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parishes(id), following INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, membership TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', person_id TEXT, is_primary INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id,parish_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_grants(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), scope_type TEXT NOT NULL, scope_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, granted_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(user_id,scope_type,scope_id,role))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_suspensions(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), scope_id TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, reason TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id,scope_id))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_history(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, actor_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id), scope_id TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_guest_requests(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parishes(id), token_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, details TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, response TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pl_guest_parish ON pl_guest_requests(parish_id,created_at)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_plans(parish_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES parishes(id), data TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_clergy_titles(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), title TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id,created_at))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_case_reviewers(concern_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES member_concerns(id), user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), PRIMARY KEY(concern_id,user_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_message_state(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), message_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES member_content(id), is_read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(user_id,message_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_ministry_requests(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), parish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parishes(id), group_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, leader_at TEXT, priest_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_invitations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parishes(id), person_id TEXT NOT NULL, token_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, claimed_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id), revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_guest_releases(request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pl_guest_requests(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uploaded_files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, released_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), released_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(request_id,file_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_profile_reviews(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parishes(id), user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), person_id TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, reviewed_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id), reviewed_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_guest_links(request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pl_guest_requests(id), user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), status TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, reviewed_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id), reviewed_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(request_id,user_id))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pl_guest_link_owner ON pl_guest_links(request_id) WHERE status='approved'
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_site_content(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_login_failures(key TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pl_login_failures_key ON pl_login_failures(key,created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_passkeys(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), public_key TEXT NOT NULL, algorithm INTEGER NOT NULL, sign_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_used_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_stats(day TEXT NOT NULL, metric TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, parish_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(day,metric,key,parish_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_visitors(day TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, device TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', lang TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY(day,hash,scope))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_stats_salt(day TEXT PRIMARY KEY, salt TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_crm(parish_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES parishes(id), stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', owner_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id), next_followup TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_crm_notes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parishes(id), author_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_signers(user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id), drawing TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', credential_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_signatures(code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parishes(id), document_type TEXT NOT NULL, document_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, signer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), signer_name TEXT NOT NULL, signer_role TEXT NOT NULL, credential_id TEXT NOT NULL, proof TEXT NOT NULL, signed_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_letters(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parish_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parishes(id), request_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, signature_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pl_signatures(code), created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
